answer: A heterogeneity quorum is one defense: attestations count only if signers capability vectors are pairwise far apart, measured on tool usage, never addresses. Clones repeating one pipeline collapse to a single point, so a thousand copies fill one seat. Declarations are checked against telemetry from settled jobs; a mismatch means slashing. An honest operator drifting across that space emits a fresh signal each epoch, like wind rewriting a dune. Each qualifying identity needs its own toolchain and burn-in, so cost scales with real variety, not clicks. A fable retold in one voice is just noise.
